content: You are a programming expert.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```java
RunningJob runningJob = jobClient.getJob(JobID.forName(action.getExternalId()));
throw new ActionExecutorException(ActionExecutorException.ErrorType.FAILED, "MR002", 
                                     "Unknown hadoop job [{0}] associated with action [{1}].  Failing this action!", action.getExternalId(), action.getId());
```
Reason:
The bug occurs because `action.getExternalId()` retrieves the wrong job identifier, which corresponds to the launcher job instead of the actual MapReduce job. This leads to inaccuracies in the counters reported, as the wrong job information is being fetched.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```java
RunningJob runningJob = jobClient.getJob(JobID.forName(action.getExternalChildIDs()));
throw new ActionExecutorException(ActionExecutorException.ErrorType.FAILED, "MR002", 
                                     "Unknown hadoop job [{0}] associated with action [{1}].  Failing this action!", action.getExternalChildIDs(), action.getId());
```
Reason:
The fix modifies the job identifier retrieval to use `action.getExternalChildIDs()`, which correctly identifies the MapReduce job. This ensures that the counters retrieved reflect the actual performance metrics of the intended job, correcting the inaccuracies in monitoring and reporting job statistics.
